description: T3 discrepancy register. Fields follow the AGENTS.md Fidelity Register vocabulary (status: proven-match, adapter-difference, proven-gap, not-audited, unresolved).

rows.scope: GPZ3 boss intro, 348 px (reported observation 1: camera rolls backwards)
rows.finding: The camera runs forward to the canonical right limit (X 1663; 1662 at the first pan update), then the pan retreats 92 px to the width-adjusted fight target 1571, at 1 px/update for 91 updates (u218..u309). The clamp carries Sonic with it: world X 1976 -> 1911. The head, invisible until the end of the pan, then appears at screen X 283 (193 at 256). At 256 the camera never moves left after the approach (retreat 12 = the takeover snap only); the ROM never moves left (retreat 0).
rows.rom_datum: GPZ3 $9A99: D282 := 1664 (exclusive; right edge 1920) at creation, head 1728 -> 1856; pan target LOCKED_CAMERA(1664,96) settles (1663,97); the camera runs INTO the limit and stops; no leftward camera motion (rom_hold x_retreat 0)
rows.poc_code_path: SCR_chaos_gpz_boss.gml:114 camera_right=1664 (not width-adjusted) vs :24 chaos_51_fight_camera_target = 1664-(W-256); :293 approach from either side at 1 px/update
rows.comparison_method: POC-SOURCE MODEL data/t3/poc-series.json GPZ3 w348 hold vs w256 vs rom-series.json (EMULATED)
rows.gameplay_impact: The camera scrolls back 92 px with Sonic dragged left by the viewport clamp, while the boss head is still invisible; visible on every approach that carries the camera to the limit (Sonic beyond boss X 1745)
rows.acceptance_proof: camera X non-decreasing from creation to fight; final camera (1571,112) at 348 and (1663,96) at 256; right screen edge 1919 at the fight in both

rows.scope: GPZ3, SEZ3, AQZ3, MGHZ3 creation-time camera takeover (256 and 348)
rows.finding: At boss creation the ordinary C1-I follow is replaced by a rigid centre follow. At 256 the camera steps backwards in ONE update: GPZ3 [-12, -11], SEZ3 [-12, -16], AQZ3 [-12, -19] (X,Y); MGHZ3 Y -7 per update for 4 updates ([0, -7] at the creation update). At 348 the same takeover is bounded to 4 px/update (GPZ3 [-4, -4], SEZ3 [-4, -4], AQZ3 [-4, -4]). THZ3 and EEZ3 have none. The ROM has no takeover: the ordinary follow keeps running (rom steps at creation [4, 0], SEZ3 [4, 0]).
rows.rom_datum: ROM boss states 0/1 never change the follow; only the left limit is raised each update ($9771 -> $8199 -> $0353)
rows.poc_code_path: SCR_chaos_camera.gml:98 chaos_camera_follow_allowed returns false once the boss is active; per-zone modes 1-2: SCR_chaos_{gpz:298,sez:592,mghz:519,aqz:627}
rows.gameplay_impact: A one-frame backward camera snap of 12 px and a Sonic position jump of 12-16 px on screen the moment the boss appears (256); a small bounded slide at 348
rows.acceptance_proof: |camera step| at the creation update <= 7 (the ROM cap) at 256 and <= 7 at 348; no negative X step at creation; Sonic screen X changes by <= his own movement + the ROM follow step

rows.scope: MGHZ3 boss intro (reported observation 2: camera pans upwards)
rows.finding: Two vertical movements, only the second is in the ROM. (1) At creation the POC camera Y goes UP 29 px at 256 (32 px at 348) in 4 (8) updates to player.y - h/1.5 (Y 238/235) because modes 1-2 keep the pre-C1-I vertical rule; the ordinary follow had Sonic at screen Y 99. (2) The pan then moves Y back DOWN 18 px (21 px at 348) to 256 while X pans. In the ROM (Sonic standing, 'stop') the camera Y changes 2 px in total ([256, 258]) because the ordinary follow already holds Y within the pan target's zone.
rows.rom_datum: pan table $9808 row 3: anchor + (-208,-32) = (3061,256); bottom limit 256 written first; the camera Y at the trigger comes from the ordinary follow (Y 258 in the ROM run)
rows.poc_code_path: SCR_chaos_mghz_boss.gml:437 chaos_56_follow_y = clamp(round(player.y-h/1.5)), capped 7 (256) / 4 (wide) per update; :519 mode-1/2 branch
rows.comparison_method: POC-SOURCE MODEL data/t3/poc-series.json MGHZ3 w256/w348 stop vs rom-series.json MGHZ3 stop
rows.gameplay_impact: An extra upward scroll of about 30 px as the boss appears (floor drops to Sonic screen Y 128), then a partial scroll back down during the pan
rows.acceptance_proof: camera Y changes at most the ROM follow step (<= 7) per update from creation; |total Y travel| from creation to pan end <= |Y(trigger) - 256| + 2; pan end Y = 256 at both widths

rows.finding: Creation is measured from the live right edge (u90 vs u102); the HUD wait that gates the pan is the same 100 updates after creation, so the pan starts at u190 vs u202. The wide pan is bounded to 4 px/update: 8 updates (X 2939 -> 2968, Y 239 -> 256) against 78 at 256 (1 px/update, X 2982 -> 3060). The boss starts descending (state 11) at the pan start in both: at 256 the camera is still panning for 76 updates of the fight, at 348 for 6. The boss ends at screen X 301 (209 at 256).
rows.rom_datum: pan 1 px/axis/update; state 11 starts at the pan (ROM rom_hold: u170, pan u168..u220)
rows.gameplay_impact: Different pan duration and a different boss position on screen; combat is not gated by the pan in the ROM or the POC
rows.acceptance_proof: if the ROM rate is kept: pan updates at 348 = max(|dX|,|dY|) = 29 (still <= the 256 value)

rows.scope: AQZ3 arena lock missing (not reported; found by this audit)
rows.finding: The POC trigger sets mode 2 but never lowers the right limit to the camera and never raises the left limit; the right limit stays 2304 until the pan, so the camera keeps following Sonic. With RIGHT held it reaches X 1893 at the pan start (ROM: 1646), then the pan retreats 166 px at 1 px/update over 165 updates (348: 76 px). A player who stops at the trigger still sees 101 px (348: 22). In the model Sonic then stays at world X 2043 (core next state $1F) while the camera retreats past him (screen X 315 of 256); the cause was not examined and may be harness-specific, so it is not used as evidence.
rows.rom_datum: AQZ3 $9771 -> $8199/$0353 each update, trigger -> $0356 (ROM: limit 1642 with the camera at 1646 on u99; data/t2/boss-arrival.json AQZ)
rows.poc_code_path: SCR_chaos_aqz_boss.gml:285 case $9771 copies limit_right only; compare SCR_chaos_sez_boss.gml:247 and SCR_chaos_mghz_boss.gml:192
rows.comparison_method: POC-SOURCE MODEL (AQZ3 w256/w348 hold and stop) vs EMULATED rom hold
rows.gameplay_impact: AQZ3 boss intro: the camera scrolls ahead of the arena and then rolls back, and the arena is not bounded to the trigger view
rows.acceptance_proof: right limit <= camera + 8 from the trigger update; camera X constant from trigger to pan start; Sonic screen X <= W-6 for every update; no negative camera X step before the fight

rows.scope: EEZ3 boss pan start (not reported; model-derived)
rows.finding: The first pan update clamps the camera Y to the new bottom limit: largest Y step in the pan 49 px at 256 and 25 px at 348, in ONE update at the pan start (Y 382 -> 333). The ROM writes the bottom limit first and then pans 1 px/update (Y 387 -> 334; largest Y step in the pan 1).
rows.rom_datum: EEZ3 state 2 -> 3: D27E := target Y, then the shared pan; no clamp of the current Y
rows.gameplay_impact: A 25-49 px vertical camera jump at the start of the EEZ3 boss pan if the model is faithful; needs a Windows capture
rows.acceptance_proof: camera Y step <= 1 per update (256) during the pan; <= 4 at 348 if the wide adapter is kept

rows.scope: Boss-arrival classification (relocated / walks in / revealed by the camera)
rows.finding: ROM: THZ3 walks in from the right by its own motion; GPZ3 relocates at creation then emerges in place; SEZ3 relocates at state 3 and drops from above; MGHZ3 is revealed by the pan while it descends; AQZ3 hides the body above the screen and flies the $5A parts in from the right; EEZ3 relocates at state 3, stays invisible through state 12 and appears at the right edge when state 6 starts, then walks in. No universal screen-edge rule exists.
rows.rom_datum: rom-series.json relocations and first_visible per zone (EMULATED + frame extents BYTE-VERIFIED)
rows.gameplay_impact: Defines what 'canonical' means per zone for the presentation decisions

rows.scope: Boss exposed earlier / more completely by the wider view (item 6)
rows.finding: With the ROM camera unchanged a 348 px window shows the first visible frame with more of the sprite: THZ3 40 of 40 columns (256: 5), MGHZ3 32 of 32 (4), EEZ3 32 columns (15); AQZ3 parts appear 90 updates earlier. GPZ3 and SEZ3 are unchanged (the sprite appears fully in place at 256 too). The POC at 348 shows THZ3 with 38 columns at screen X 330, MGHZ3 32 columns at 322, GPZ3 at screen X 283; EEZ3 shows 15 columns (the relocation keeps the ROM sliver) and AQZ3 hides the parts until the pan has settled 16 updates.
rows.rom_datum: ROM sliver entries: THZ3 5 columns, MGHZ3 4, EEZ3 15, AQZ3 1 (data/t3/rom-series.json, frame-extents.json)
rows.gameplay_impact: THZ3 and MGHZ3 bosses pop into the right edge region instead of sliding in; no boss is visible before it exists or before its state allows it
rows.acceptance_proof: first-visible anchor screen X and columns recorded per width

rows.scope: Horizontal framing of Sonic during modes 1-2
rows.finding: Because the left limit is raised to the camera and the target is the view centre, the camera stalls until Sonic passes the centre. Sonic's screen X when the arena right limit is lowered (the lock): MGHZ3 ROM 116, POC 256 132, POC 348 178; SEZ3 ROM 116, POC 256 132, POC 348 178. In the ROM Sonic stays on the follow lead (116) until the lock.
rows.rom_datum: ROM follow zone lead +- 8 around 104/136 (CENTER-24/+8 at wide by decision D1-A)
rows.gameplay_impact: Cosmetic: Sonic drifts 16 px (256) / 28 px (348) right of his usual screen position before the lock
rows.acceptance_proof: Sonic screen X at the lock within the follow zone

rows.finding: T2-01/T2-02/T1-01: no screen clamp in modes 1-2 (Sonic max screen X 443 at 256 and 441 at 348; 54 / 96 updates beyond the clamp), centre follow, Y frozen at 126 until the pan (ROM follows Y to 131). The pan, the walk-on world positions and the state 18 -> 6 position (world 1902) are ROM-faithful at both widths.
